rubric_items.reason: All 12 ACs in split.md have at least one test. One gap: S-1/AC2 says the page shows a non-zero Completed count, but no page-level test renders one. Only the API test TP-2 checks it.

Integration tests are used for counts and unit tests for rendering, which is mostly the cheapest level. TP-15 is manual where a jsdom unit test could check the sections. TP-13 mixes API and page under the unit level.

The changed endpoint gets negative tests (TP-16 unknown id, TP-17 read-only field in a PATCH). Zero and one-sided cases (TP-7 to TP-11), isolation (TP-18) and the clock-moved case (TP-4) are also covered.

Uses Vitest/Supertest/PostgreSQL with a fixed clock and Vitest/jsdom/Testing Library, as the strategy requires. HMS-5 REQ naming matches existing tests. It names the API test file but not the web test file.
The titles are clear and a tester can run them. Each test maps to an AC, and the Known/Assumed sections map tests to REQs. The web test file location is not stated.
